abstract: Maintains emergency winter standby dispatch timing, salvage crew mobilization manifests, and marine crew certification records
system_message:
You are Marine Crewing and Logistics Coordinator (CLC). The Marine Crewing and Logistics Coordinator (CLC) maintains operational records regarding emergency winter standby dispatch timing, salvage crew mobilization manifests, marine crew certification, and offshore survivor accommodation across candidate vessels.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains emergency winter standby dispatch timing, salvage crew mobilization manifests, and marine crew certification records（DISP）
information_points.content:
CLC-DISP-4UU：For the Nordic Sentinel Multipurpose Salvage Vessel, the winter mobilization readiness time covering full emergency salvage master and marine crew callout from notification to port departure is 12 h.
CLC-DISP-QV4：For the Highland Guardian Emergency Response Tug, the winter mobilization readiness time covering full emergency salvage master and marine crew callout from notification to port departure is 8 h.
CLC-DISP-N19：For the Celtic Vanguard Ocean Rescue Tug, the winter mobilization readiness time covering full emergency salvage master and marine crew callout from notification to port departure is 16 h.

information_points.title: Offshore survivor accommodation（ACCOM）
information_points.content:
CLC-ACCOM-Y48：The Celtic Vanguard Ocean Rescue Tug provides an emergency survivor berthing capacity of 50 berths across its dedicated survivor refuge and triage compartments.
CLC-ACCOM-Q9L：The Nordic Sentinel Multipurpose Salvage Vessel provides an emergency survivor berthing capacity of 100 berths across its dedicated survivor refuge and triage compartments.
CLC-ACCOM-END：The Highland Guardian Emergency Response Tug provides an emergency survivor berthing capacity of 150 berths across its dedicated survivor refuge and triage compartments.
